name: Skipper Walt

intro.text: Silver Cod Trophy, three years running: top catch of the whole Hull fleet. The Silver Cod went to the best skipper in Hull or Grimsby every year, and mostly it came to Hull.
I'll not go easy. The sea never did.

win: Well. I've been beaten by the North Atlantic, the Icelandic navy and now you. You're in good company.
after: When the Cod Wars ended in 1976, Iceland had won its 200-mile limit and Hull lost its grounds. A whole way of life went in a few years. Remember them when you eat your haddock.
